name: Nonprofit & NGO
description: Donations, grants, impact measurement, and beneficiary program data
rules: Donor and beneficiary PII minimized; impact reports use aggregates
Grant spend must reconcile to restricted fund ledgers
Campaign attribution windows documented and versioned

memories: Year-end giving spikes overwhelm CRM APIs — prefer bulk/CDC
Multi-currency donations need FX as-of donation timestamp
